scientific_interpretation.finding: An independent ResearchGate publication record timestamps author-uploaded full article content containing the same Ethereum Tuesday coefficient and p-value to 2024-08-12, before the project's frozen 2025-05-12 screen start. This closes the prior source-rule existence chronology gap without claiming cryptographic immutability of the historical bytes.
